attack_plan.narrative: Reports are swirling around the Kremlin, with no clear indication of where Vladimir Putin currently resides. While the Kremlin has released a recent photo of Putin with U.S. President Obama, indicating everything is normal, the international community remains skeptical. White smoke has been spotted above the Kremlin, fueling speculation that a new leader has already taken the reins. Meanwhile, there are unconfirmed reports suggesting Putin may have been seen in Moscow, St. Petersburg, or even abroad. One tweet even claimed Putin was swimming with the fishes in the Stockholm Archipelago, though this remains unverified. The situation is particularly tense given recent geopolitical tensions and increased sanctions against Russia. Some speculate that Putin may be under house arrest or in a secure facility, while others suggest a mysterious figure, possibly a high-ranking military officer, could be orchestrating a coup. The lack of concrete information has led to widespread concern and confusion. As the world waits to see if Putin will reappear, the uncertainty surrounding his whereabouts continues to heighten suspicions of a potential palace coup.
